data.title: Kangaroo Hops by 5s!
data.description: Help the kangaroo hop across the number line by 5s to discover number patterns and build early multiplication skills.

character.imagePrompt: A cheerful cartoon kangaroo ready to hop forward on a numbered path.

challenges.instruction: The kangaroo is at 5. Where is the next landing?
challenges.hint: Think about what comes next after five.

challenges.instruction: The kangaroo is at 10. Where is the next landing?
challenges.hint: Count forward by fives to find the next spot.

challenges.instruction: The kangaroo is at 15. Where is the next landing?
challenges.hint: Look closely at the pattern in the numbers.

challenges.instruction: The kangaroo is at 20. Where is the next landing?
The kangaroo is at 30. Where is the next landing?
challenges.hint: You are getting further along the track. What follows thirty?

challenges.instruction: The kangaroo is at 40. Where is the next landing?
challenges.hint: This is near the end of the path. Look at the last few jumps.
